what: Sanitizer skip-upsert logic keys off SKIP_REASON substrings and the literal sanitizer-rejected, but real sanitizer-driven SKIP_REASON values are usually REASON_TOKEN slugs from generate-code-flow-diagram.sh awk extraction, which do not contain reject, rejected, or sanitiz.
scenario_or_breakage: Normal sanitizer rejections set SKIP_REASON to tokens like pipe-in-node-label (see skills/implement/scripts/generate-code-flow-diagram.sh:104 and scripts/sanitize-mermaid-fragment.sh REASON_TOKEN prints); COMMENT_UPSERT_SKIP stays false if the plan is followed literally, so tracking-issue upsert runs contrary to Round 1 Decision 2 and test case 3 expectations.
suggested_fix: Treat STATUS=skipped from generate-code-flow-diagram.sh as the authoritative sanitizer-rejection branch (sole emission at skills/implement/scripts/generate-code-flow-diagram.sh:101-104), keep sanitizer-rejected as an extra signal only, and document that sanitize-mermaid-fragment.sh emits STATUS=rejected plus REASON_TOKEN lines (scripts/sanitize-mermaid-fragment.sh:269-273), not the string sanitizer-rejected.

what: Phase 6 claims the sanitizer emits a known REASON_TOKEN labeled sanitizer-rejected.
scenario_or_breakage: sanitizer-rejected is produced only as generate-code-flow-diagram.sh s awk fallback when no REASON_TOKEN line matches (skills/implement/scripts/generate-code-flow-diagram.sh:104); primary sanitize KV is STATUS=rejected (scripts/sanitize-mermaid-fragment.sh:270).
suggested_fix: Rephrase to attribute sanitizer-rejected to the generator fallback and REASON_TOKEN=<slug> to sanitize-mermaid-fragment.sh per scripts/sanitize-mermaid-fragment.md:43-44.

what: Test case diagram-rejected stubs STATUS=failed while the live helper emits STATUS=skipped on sanitizer rejection.
scenario_or_breakage: Harness passes the plan s substring checks for SKIP_REASON=sanitizer-rejected but does not exercise STATUS=skipped parsing, so regressions in the skipped branch could slip past CI.
suggested_fix: Stub STATUS=skipped with SKIP_REASON set to a representative REASON_TOKEN slug (or sanitizer-rejected) and assert COMMENT_UPSERT_SKIP against that envelope.

what: SKIP_REASON awk uses FS== so the first REASON_TOKEN line yields $2 including trailing fence metadata (e.g. pipe-in-node-label fence).
scenario_or_breakage: step-7a substring logic is even less reliable if future heuristics parse SKIP_REASON sloppily; root fix belongs in the generator, not step-7a.
suggested_fix: Narrow awk to print only the token field or use match/substr; out of scope for the step-7a plan unless the issue explicitly expands scope.
